intro.text: The lighteyed citylord of Hearthstone, a frail man and a friend of the town's surgeon, Lirin.

items.text: Wistiow became citylord of Hearthstone and had one daughter, Laral. He let the townspeople largely run their own lives, and became close friends with Lirin. The two joked about other lighteyes and hoped that Kaladin and Laral might one day marry, a match that would have helped both families.

Not long after an army came through town to recruit some of the older boys, Wistiow fell ill. Lirin tended him in his manor as he weakened and lost his lucidity. Fearing for the planned marriage, Lirin drew up documents, including a simple will leaving Kaladin spheres for his schooling in Kharbranth. Wistiow was too confused to stamp them, so Lirin did it himself, and Wistiow died soon after.

personality.text: A modest lighteyes, Wistiow kept a single old horse and paid little attention to his manor's grounds. He had no patience for lighteyes who spent their time hunting.
